sidebar.title: Design Assistant
sidebar.greeting: Hi! I can help you generate and customize building designs. To get started, I'll need a few details: floor plan dimensions, building section, roof shape and layout, eaves shape, and attic usage.

generateSample.title: Generate a sample design
generateSample.message: Generate a sample building design: a 10x12m house with a Gable roof at 30° pitch, Open eaves, Brick walls, located in Bratislava, with Storage attic and 450mm overhang.

pricing.title: Pricing Breakdown
pricing.floorAreaTooltip: Width × Height of the floor plan
pricing.gussetPlateCostTooltip: Total Joints × Cost per Joint (40 CZK)
pricing.timberCostTooltip: Timber Volume × Timber Cost per m³ (4,500 CZK)
pricing.assemblyCostTooltip: Total Trusses ÷ 20 × Assembly Cost per Batch (15,000 CZK)
pricing.hangerCostTooltip: Total Trusses × Hanger Cost per Truss (100 CZK)
pricing.subtotalTooltip: Sum of Gusset Plate Cost + Timber Cost + Assembly Cost + Hanger Cost
pricing.roofTypeTooltip: Complexity factor applied based on roof type (Gable: ×1.0, Hip: ×1.3, Mono-pitch: ×0.9, Flat: ×0.8)
pricing.totalEURTooltip: Total CZK ÷ 25 (CZK to EUR conversion rate)
